$comment: The wrapper settings every section carries, stored in a group named settings on each section. Merged from Salt for Next.js's sectionSettings (13 fields, stored under settings) and Salt for WordPress's five Advanced-tab wrapper fields (stored at the layout's top level as section_*). A section file may change a default or omit a field through its shared object.

fields.name: spacing
fields.label: Spacing
fields.description: Space above and below the section.

wordpress.owes: storing it in the settings group

fields.name: tone
fields.label: Tone
fields.description: The section's background and text colour roles.

options.label: Surface, alternate (a subtle step away from it)

wordpress.owes: storing it in the settings group, and the value surface-inverse in place of inverse

fields.name: toneDark
fields.label: Dark mode tone
fields.description: The tone in dark mode. Automatic uses the counterpart of the tone above.

options.label: Automatic (the counterpart of the tone above)

nextjs.owes: the value auto in place of an empty string

wordpress.owes: the field; dark mode is a token inversion today, with no per-section choice

fields.name: width
fields.label: Width
fields.description: How wide the section's content runs.

wordpress.owes: storing it in the settings group

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Decorative: hidden from screen readers, with empty alternative text.

options.label: Cover (fill the section, cropping as needed)

nextjs.owes: the value focal-point in place of an empty string

fields.name: scrim
fields.label: Tint the image with the section's colour behind the text

wordpress.owes: the background image and its four settings

fields.name: anchorId
fields.label: Anchor
fields.description: Optional, for links to this section. Made URL-safe on save. The reserved ids main, content, header, footer, nav, site-navigation, search and skip-link, and repeats on a page, take a numeric suffix (-2, -3), as markup/section#anchors says.

nextjs.owes: reserving site-navigation in place of navigation, the id its header's main navigation takes (SC-006)

wordpress.owes: storing it in the settings group; reserving site-navigation in place of primary-navigation, the id its header's main navigation takes (SC-006)

fields.name: firstPageOnly
fields.label: First page only
fields.description: On a paginated index, hide this section after the first page.

wordpress.owes: the field, with the listing section that paginates

fields.name: divider
fields.label: Rule above this section
fields.description: A hairline rule between this section and the one before. It also stops two sections of the same tone running together.

wordpress.owes: storing it in the settings group; drawing the rule above the section, not after its content (SC-006)
wordpress.note: Labelled Divider line; draws the rule after the content today.
